name: raluca-andrenacci
description: Raluca Andrenacci website: React + TypeScript + Tailwind frontend, Express + PostgreSQL backend

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @raluca/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @raluca/shared" "npm run dev -w @raluca/api" "npm run dev -w @raluca/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @raluca/shared && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @raluca/web && npm run build -w @raluca/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @raluca/shared && npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck -ws --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @raluca/shared && npm run db:generate && npm run test -ws --if-present
